for path in index['fresh_capture_and_actual_command_paths']:assert not os.path.lexists(path),path
state=json.loads(Path('/home/holden/mckernel/.git/os-autopilot/state.json').read_bytes());assert state['phase']=='running' and not state.get('pause_reason') and state['last_rate_limits']['primary']['usedPercent']<100
storage={}
for label,path,floor in [('host','/home/holden/mckernel',16<<30),('scratch','/home/holden/mckernel-work/scratch',12<<30)]:
 st=os.statvfs(path);storage[label]=st.f_bavail*st.f_frsize;assert storage[label]>=floor+679477248+8388608
mem=next(int(x.split()[1])*1024 for x in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('MemAvailable:'));assert mem>=17850957824
for pid,birth in ((2777042,40959744),(2590193,37928121)):assert int(Path('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/stat').read_bytes().rsplit(b')',1)[1].split()[19])==birth and os.sched_getaffinity(pid)=={0}
lock=Path('/run/lock/mckernel-development.lock').lstat();assert (lock.st_dev,lock.st_ino)==(27,4)
for path in ('/home/holden/mckernel-work/scratch/mckernel-heavy-operation.lock',):assert not os.path.lexists(path)
obj=dict(status='PASS_IMMEDIATE_EXACT_M07_SEVEN_ADMISSION_BEFORE_LIVE_GATES',at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),review_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r).hexdigest(),candidate_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),usage_percent=state['last_rate_limits']['primary']['usedPercent'],storage_available_bytes=storage,mem_available_bytes=mem,source_and_foreground_quiescent=True,registered_progress_paths=17,sole_heavy=True,permanent_mutex=[27,4],future_live_snapshot_and_guard_still_required=True)
p=d/'ROOT-IMMEDIATE-EXACT-SEVEN-ADMISSION-1.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\\n');os.execv(argv[0],argv)
